forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3ETSEG8QR1Y31J1FB1A2YQB
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: Keep the 120 s bound on inner tools.* and MCP calls now that ToolMount has no default timeout
+---
+## What
+Before, `ToolMount.init(mode:timeout:)` defaulted `timeout` to `defaultTimeoutSeconds` (120 s). In the new Router the default is `nil`, which means no deadline (`../FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Hosting/ToolMount.swift:31`). Multitool code that took the old default now has no bound, and no error shows this:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Invocation/RunBinding.swift`: `static let innerCallMount = ToolMount(mode: .runToCompletion)` bounds each inner `tools.*` call and each MCP call made under a context. The file header of `Capabilities/MCP/MCPServer+Call.swift` says that "the engine's clock ... bounds every call made under a context".
+- [ ] Run `rg -n 'ToolMount\(' Sources` and list each construction that relied on the default timeout.
+- [ ] Give each one an explicit `timeout: MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit`, or the configured `executionTimeLimit` where a configuration is in scope. For a mount that must have no bound, write the reason in a comment.
+- [ ] Update the doc comments of `innerCallMount` and `MCPServer+Call.swift` so that they name the constant.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `RunBinding.innerCallMount.timeout == MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit`.
+- [ ] An MCP call made under a context, to a server that makes no progress, ends with a timeout error at the bound. It does not hang.
+- [ ] Each `ToolMount(` in `Sources/` states `timeout:`, or has a comment that says why it has none.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/RunBindingTests.swift:30`: assert against `MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/MCPServerCallTests.swift`: add a test with a short injected bound and `Support/HangingTransport.swift`. The call must end with a timeout error.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter 'RunBindingTests|MCPServerCallTests|HardeningTests'`. Expected result: it passes. Run this after the unit-test task makes the test target compile.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write failing tests first, then do the implementation that makes them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
